416| def main(mode, ambassador_config_dir, envoy_config_file, delay, pid):
417|     """This script watches the kubernetes API for changes in services. It
418|     collects ambassador configuration imput from the ambassador
419|     annotation on any services, and whenever these change, it will
420|     generate a new set of ambassador configuration inputs. It will
421|     then diff these inputs with the previous configuration and if
422|     necessary regenerate an envoy configuration and initiate an envoy
423|     restart.
424| 
425|     Envoy is engineered to restart with zero connection loss, but this
426|     process takes time and needs to be properly managed in two ways:
427|     both timing of restarts and validation of inputs to the new envoy.
428| 
429|     Restarting with zero connection loss takes time. The new envoy
430|     initiates a drain period in the old envoy (see envoy's
431|     --drain-time-s option), and then there is a further delay before
432|     the new envoy shuts down the old one (see envoy's
433|     --parent-shutdown-time-s option). Any attempt to initiate another
434|     restart while the previous restart is already in progress will
435|     fail. This means we need to take further care not to initiate
436|     restarts too frequently. This leaves us with three delay
437|     parameters that needed to be tuned with increasing values that
438|     have sufficient margins:
439|     
440|       --drain-time-s (an envoy parameter)

140|             return 0

154| class ReleaseDelta(object):

156|     FIX   = VersionDelta( (0,0,1), Version.next_patch, "[FIX]")
157|     MINOR = VersionDelta( (0,1,0), Version.next_minor, "[MINOR]")
158|     MAJOR = VersionDelta( (1,0,0), Version.next_major, "[MAJOR]")
